title: Stevie Johnson: Keon Coleman can be the best, we're working on how to make it show

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Stevie Johnson: Keon Coleman can be the best, we're working on how to make it show
sources.description: Bills wide receiver Keon Coleman believes he's facing a "make or break" 2026 season and his preparation for it has included work with former Bills star Stevie Johnson.
